description.value:
You gain one of the following features of your choice.

  • Spirit Claw. When you are hidden, you ignore Immunity to the Lacerated condition and healing does not remove the Lacerated condition if it was applied by you unless the target was healed back to its hitpoint maximum. Additionally, you have Advantage on Attack Rolls against creatures that are Lacerated.
  • Feline Grace. No Attack Roll has Advantage against you and you cannot have Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws and Ability Checks. You lose these benefits when you are Incapacitated or your Speed is 0.
  • Killing Bite. If you hit a Prone creature with your natural weapons, you can immediately make another attack with them as a Bonus Action.
